title: Trapped Beans
body:
Description

Trapped Beans can be bought at the Classic Store for $4,891. If you unseal the can, it will explode. it has an red x on the bottom of the can that resembles the x on the in game map though its uses are still unknown. It is to distinguish the explosive trapped beans from the not explosive, canned beans.

The description says: :) little do they know... I'M SECRETLY A BOMB!
